auditType: Source, packaging and stored-evidence review; no new model execution, remote health check, invoice retrieval or independent scientific benchmark.
actionInventoryScope: Literal action sets only; source presence does not establish exposed IPC, working execution or acceptance of every action.

motif_find.method: Exact IUPAC motif enumeration; no activity score

rna_ensemble.method: ViennaRNA partition function, centroid, MEA and marginal accessibility

reference_window.method: Exact pinned assembly sequence and strand-aware coordinates

variant_vep.method: Assembly- and allele-checked Ensembl VEP consequence annotation

scanpy_analysis.method: Pinned Scanpy QC, normalization, PCA, UMAP, Leiden and exploratory cluster markers

pathway_enrichment.method: Explicit-background hypergeometric over-representation with BH/BY adjustment

chimeraXCommandInventory.scope: Historical CSV command-specific inventory; no new validation implied.

editcraftRequirementClosure.countingPolicy: Original paragraphs and qualifiers retained. Headings and grouped lists are not silently removed. Unreviewed clauses carry not_started for their acceptance review, which does not assert absence of all implementation; inherited feature source references are context, not evidence. No subjective completion percentage.

auditExclusions: No new scientific calculation or model inference
No rerun of recorded regression suites
No new security, license or fresh-machine certification
